QuestInfo.name: A New Friend?
QuestInfo.0: You received a message from Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart wants you to meet a new ally, Irena the Wind Archer. She is currently training on Victoria Island. Meet up with her at the #b#m104020000##k.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart wants you to meet a new ally. She is currently training on Victoria Island. You met up with her, Irena, at the Six Path Crossway.

0.0: You look as if a burden has been lifted from your shoulders. I hope this will be the end of your moping around, because I have an assignment for you.
0.1: Not long ago, a woman named Irena came to Ereve to pledge her service to Empress Cygnus. I was caught off guard by her looks, but her skills with the bow were rather impressive.
0.2: She told me she was traveling to Victoria Island for training. Find her, gain her trust. She will make a valuable ally. Begin your search at the #b#m104020000##k. I can send you to the #b#m104020000##k right now, if you want.

no.0: You would be unwise to ignore this woman.

1.0: You must be the knight. Neinheart and Kiku told me you were quite a soldier. Did you come all the way out here just to see me?\r\n#L0##bI, uh... I guess I did. Nice to meet you.#l\n#k
1.1: Training in Ereve can only teach you so much, so I came out to Victoria Island for some real-world experience. There's a vast world of adventure out there just waiting for me! \r\n#L0##bYou must be pretty... brave if you jumped straight to Victoria Island with no training. #l\n#k
1.2: I look forward to working with you!

npc.0: You will recognize her the moment you see her. Archers always have... a way about them.
